facts.text: Florida A&M University is a public, historically Black university located in Tallahassee and is the only historically Black university in the 12-member State University System of Florida.

sources.title: About FAMU
sources.quote: Founded October 3, 1887, Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University (FAMU) is a public, historically Black university located in Tallahassee, Florida.
